attr.title: ITGmania
attr.desc: ITGmania is a fork of StepMania 5.1, the open-source rhythm game, focused on In The Groove-style play with the Simply Love theme. This port adapts the engine, the theme and the controls to handheld screens (16:9, letterboxed on taller ones) and built-in buttons.
attr.inst: Ready to run with the three songs ITGmania ships. Add song packs (a folder of song folders) to ports/itgmania/Songs/. The first start after adding packs processes them and can take a few minutes (about 90 seconds for 1,700 songs). Currently supports Allwinner H700 devices running muOS only (it uses muOS's Mali fbdev SDL2 driver).
attr.inst_md:
- Ready to run with the three songs ITGmania ships.
- Add song packs (a folder of song folders) to `ports/itgmania/Songs/`.
- The first start after adding packs processes them and can take a few minutes (about 90 seconds for 1,700 songs).
- Currently supports **Allwinner H700 devices running muOS** only (it uses muOS's Mali fbdev SDL2 driver).
